title: 第9章 炼丹失败那些年柳仙有福了柳仙 你真该死练成功了第10章 多宝图谋尔等到吾道场撒野真敢吾不敢杀人
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 昆仑山山脉。
青渊游历于此地。
时不时遁入云下山脉中拾取宝物。
不得不说云中子的福缘逆天。
青渊这些天遨游昆仑山山脉，平日间所见的凶戾古兽、生灵竟见不到几头，反倒是各种各样的天材地宝、仙金神料裸露于大地供他采摘。
虽不是样样都先天灵根、宝药。
亦都是些罕见的灵药、材料云云。
若在平常，他就是贴着山地毯式搜索几百上千年都不一定找得到。
可现在。
他随便往地上看去，便见山岳中有灵光闪烁，找个地方休息，坐着的石头都是千百万年所形成的仙金神料矿脉，简直是开挂一般的行走。
在外搜索个千年左右。
顺带将三百万年道行转修《九转玄功》让肉身境界也踏入玄仙境初期。
青渊便选择了回道场。
至于为何不继续搜索天材地宝了呢？
是因为他深刻记得后世的一句话：运气这玩意，谁先用完谁先走。
正好他有一件万物造化鼎，能有几率让丹药、法宝铸成的概率增加并且本源晋升的概率，甚至拥有亿万分之一的返先天或是晋升品级几率。
对此。
他想回去看看自己的炼丹、炼器天赋如何。
青渊腾云驾雾回归道场，脚下山河滚滚向后流淌。
回到道场附近的时候。
青渊看到无支祁正在搬运一截河流，不免好奇道：“徒儿，你这是在做什么？”
“师父，我觉得我的水府水太少太沉闷了，所以想搬运些水去扩宽水府，所以才跋山涉水去运水。”
无支祁见到青渊，连忙跪下行礼。
“原来如此，运水不需要这么麻烦，将这截水放回去，为师帮你。”
“多谢师父！”
无支祁大喜，便将手里的一截河流给撤掉，屁颠颠的跟青渊回了道场。
“见过师父！”
在道场里跟柳仙聊天的云中子看到两人回来，面露喜色前去迎接。
“好久不见，徒儿道行又精进了不少啊。”
看到云中子已经真仙境中期了，青渊也有些汗颜。
自己出去瞎溜达快千年了，也不过元神修炼至玄仙境巅峰，肉身踏入玄仙境初期罢了，这徒弟就真仙中期了？
“闭关小有感悟罢了。”
云中子面露惭愧。
自从发现‘人外有人’之后，他回了道场便潜心修行，加上没有什么境界瓶颈，方才突破快的。
“看来为师也要努力修行，免得都要被你们超过了啊。”
content_en:
Kunlun Mountains.
Qingyuan traveled here.
From time to time, he would escape into the Yunxia Mountains to pick up treasures.
It has to be said that Yun Zhongzi's good fortune is incredible.
Qingyuan has been traveling around the Kunlun Mountains these days, and he has seen very few ferocious ancient beasts and creatures. Instead, there are all kinds of heavenly and earthly treasures, immortal gold and divine materials exposed on the earth for him to pick.
Although not everything has innate spiritual roots and precious medicine.
They are also some rare elixirs and materials.
Normally, he might not be able to find it even if he searches like a carpet for hundreds or thousands of years.
But now.
He looked casually on the ground and saw a flash of spiritual light in the mountains. He found a place to rest. The stones he sat on were veins of immortal gold and divine materials formed over millions of years. It was like he was walking around cheating.
Search outside for about a thousand years.
By the way, he transferred three million years of Taoism to practice the "Nine Transformations Mysterious Art", allowing his physical body to enter the early stage of the Mysterious Immortal Realm.
Qingyuan then chose to return to the dojo.
As for why you don’t continue searching for heavenly materials and earthly treasures?
It's because he deeply remembered a saying from later generations: Whoever runs out of luck first will leave first.
It just so happens that he has a cauldron of creation, which can increase the probability of casting elixirs and magic weapons, and increase the probability of origin promotion. He even has a one-in-a-billion chance of returning to innateness or being promoted to a higher level.
To this.
He wanted to go back and see how his talents in alchemy and weapon refining were.
Qingyuan returned to the dojo in the clouds and mist, and the mountains and rivers at his feet rolled backwards.
When I returned to the vicinity of the dojo.
When Qingyuan saw Wuzhiqi carrying a section of the river, he couldn't help but asked curiously: "Disciple, what are you doing?"
"Master, I felt that the water in my water palace was too little and too boring, so I wanted to carry some water to expand the water palace, so I traveled across mountains and rivers to transport water."
When Wuzhiqi saw Qingyuan, he quickly knelt down and saluted.
"That's it. It doesn't need to be so troublesome to transport water. Put this water back and I will help you."
"Thank you Master!"
Wuzhiqi was so happy that he removed a section of the river from his hand and followed Qingyuan back to the dojo.
"I've met the master!"
Yun Zhongzi, who was chatting with Liu Xian in the dojo, saw the two returning and went to greet them with a happy face.
"Long time no see, my disciple has improved a lot in his practice."
Seeing that Yun Zhongzi was already in the middle stage of the True Immortal Realm, Qingyuan was also a little ashamed.
I have been wandering around for almost a thousand years, but my soul has only reached the peak of the Mysterious Immortal Realm and my physical body has entered the early stage of the Mysterious Immortal Realm. Is this apprentice in the middle stage of the True Immortal Realm?
"It's just a little retreat to gain some insights."
Yun Zhongzi looked ashamed.
Ever since he discovered that "there is someone outside the world", he returned to the dojo and devoted himself to practice. Since there were no bottlenecks in his realm, he was able to break through quickly.
"It seems that as a teacher, I have to practice hard to avoid being surpassed by you all."
